results.title: StaticTendencies
results.overview: An artistic, experimental short that reflects on the horrors of isolation, loneliness, and addiction. This film challenges its viewers to think abstractly.

results.title: Broken Road
results.overview: A struggling college student fumbles his way through the stress that comes with it. Missing and failed assignments lead to a very dangerous way of coping with his problems.
The experience of Maya's grief and despair from a past traumatic experience.

results.title: Niu Forever
results.overview: Niu Forever invites you into the heart of Hawai'i, where the niu - or coconut tree - embodies resilience, food sovereignty, and cultural reawakening. See how communities come together to protect genetic diversity, combat invasive species, and find healing through their deep connection to land and each other.

results.title: Remember When…
results.overview: When a mysterious phone call disrupts her quiet evening, a young woman finds herself caught between the comfort of the past and a reality she refuses to confront. As familiar voices and childhood memories begin to blur, she must face the unsettling truth of what she's been trying to forget.

results.title: Never Again
results.overview: Historically, war has been regarded as a man’s domain, making the presence of women on blood-soaked battlefields all the more heroic. Yet neither men nor women, nor humanity as a whole, have managed to make any previous war the last one. The Doomsday Clock keeps ticking forward, and there is no reason to stop its second hand.

results.title: Punk Brighton
results.overview: The documentary utilizes 15 years of interviews, live performance archives, and animation to capture the city's fierce DIY music scene. Rather than focusing solely on the music, it explores how the communal movement tackled broader political and social issues, including confronting fascism, rocking against racism, and rallying the community to save the Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club.

results.title: Death of Truth
results.overview: The orderly, solitary life of Feridun is shaken by the arrival of his old friend Timuçin, who carries the burden of murders they committed in the past. As Timuçin contemplates turning himself in, Feridun must stop him to protect his own freedom.

results.title: Ancient Blue
results.overview: Kenan Yelkıran, a solitary fisherman whose boat was seized due to his debts, goes missing in the heart of a deadly storm. When he washes ashore two months later—his mind a vast, empty void—the town receives him with a dark and unsettling suspicion. As Kenan struggles to piece together his shattered sense of reality, the cursed spirits of ancient times and the ceaseless whispers of the sea begin to haunt his mind. The time has finally come: Kenan must confront the terrifying secret buried deep within his own consciousness and put an end to this age-old cycle of sin.

results.title: Elisa
results.overview: Following a nuclear war, life on Earth has all but come to an end. Solisvita has placed a small group in an ancient cavern—equipped with a 180-day supply of water and provisions—tasking them with locating a rare "ore" essential for producing "Geneterna," a treatment designed to grant humans genetic immunity to radiation. Once the mission is complete, they are to be relocated to protected "Fortress Cities." However, communication with headquarters is severed, their water supply is running dangerously low, and with only eight days left in the mission, Emre—the project lead—takes his own life. Meanwhile, a mysterious stranger arrives at their door, sharing legends that hint at a hidden water source deep within the cavern. As trust begins to unravel, each member of the group is forced to confront the true cost of survival and the real nature of Solisvita—the organization they once believed to be their savior.

results.title: A Good Hand Wasted
results.overview: A luxury island getaway turns deadly when six friends join a mysterious dealer's poker game, where every losing hand means a round of Russian roulette.

results.title: My Father from the Island Russia
Birdie
results.overview: Through the medium of an intimate video diary, Mariana Macháňová captures her family’s grief as her mother passes away. For the director, the camera becomes a tool for both therapy and detachment. She records her wanderings through sterile hospital corridors, taking perhaps her last selfie with her mother at her hospital bedside, and the scattering of her ashes. Coming to terms with the loss also gives rise to reflections on the ethics of such filming. The filmmaker asks herself whether it is acceptable to enter moments of greatest vulnerability with a camera, if the act of filming itself helps to transform fleeting fragments into something lasting and thus to process the mourning.  “So I decided I’d heal myself with a film”

results.title: Hating
results.overview: Ondřej Šálek’s time-lapse documentary captures an escalating street battle between pro-Russian activists at a petition stall in Prague’s Klárov district and a group of liberal-minded citizens who have decided to take justice into their own hands. Footage from live streams and first-hand observations reveal verbal and physical altercations and the growing radicalisation of both camps. This unsettling account of the forms taken by civil resistance in a sharply polarised society does not adopt the perspective of either side. An impartial observation of the actions and counter-actions shows how easily a sense of threat and the desire to belong to a particular community can escalate into aggression.

results.title: Her Daughters’ Mother
results.overview: After getting married at the age of 16, Ejiro is thrown into a world she is unprepared for, seeking freedom and agency in hopeless places.
